learningObjective: See how sample size and metric variance jointly determine the minimum effect an experiment can reliably detect.
mediumRationale: A deterministic SVG of minimum detectable effect curves makes the inverse-square-root relationship spatial. Mermaid cannot express the quantitative curve, and interaction is unnecessary for the first version.

pages.insight: The source deck makes online experimentation the final evidence step in ML system design and asks for a stated effect hypothesis.
The Rules of ML section warns that identical short-term behavior does not imply identical long-term behavior and stresses measuring model deltas.
